out.title: V. Srinivasa Rangan reappointed as Whole-time Director for one year
out.summary: HDFC Bank's Board approved re-appointment of V. Srinivasa Rangan as Whole-time Director (Executive Director) for one year from November 23, 2026, at extant remuneration, following RBI approval, subject to shareholder approval.

person.name: V. Srinivasa Rangan
person.bio: Aged 66, former Executive Director & CFO of HDFC Limited; B.Com (Delhi University), Associate of ICAI; heads HR, legal, secretarial, investment banking and other functions; director on Credila and HDFC AMC boards.
